column1: # what-this-is: a FINGERPRINT for detecting a rollback, not a backup of the edits
# WHY A FINGERPRINT AND NOT A NODE LIST. Roughly 700 nodes were rebound across 2026-09-11 and -12.
# tokens/_raw/deprecated-rebinds-applied.tsv holds 26 of them; the rest were applied by runs that
# logged a COUNT rather than their targets, which is the failure that file was created in response
# to. So the ids of about 96% of those writes do not exist anywhere.
# AND A CURRENT-STATE SNAPSHOT WOULD NOT FIX THAT, which is the thing worth being clear about. To
# RESTORE an edit you need the state BEFORE it, and nobody captured that. A snapshot of what is
# there now can only tell you that something changed — it cannot tell you what to put back. Figma's
# own version history is the only thing that can, and it is outside this repo.
# So this file does the job that IS achievable from here: two whole-file censuses, each swept twice
# and agreeing, that a later sweep can be diffed against. If any of these numbers moves and nobody
# did the work, the file has been rolled back or edited elsewhere.
# A 414-row dump of every deprecated-style node was attempted and abandoned deliberately. It has to
# cross the chat in 20KB chunks and be retyped into this file — a HAND-COPY, which this repo has
# been bitten by three separate times — and a half-transcribed list is worse than no list, by the
# same rule that makes every extractor here refuse to shrink. The 35 that ship are written out in
# full in deprecated-shipped-worklist.tsv, node by node, because those are the ones anyone acts on.
# ── CENSUS 1: nodes bound to each semantic variable this work wrote ──────────
# Whole file, every page, two agreeing sweeps: 15001 BINDINGS across 17 variables, on 14945 nodes
# (56 nodes carry both a fill and a stroke binding). Census 2 below counts the NODES.
# These are NOT all mine — the overwhelming majority predate this work. That is the point: the
# number is a fingerprint, and a fingerprint does not need to be attributable to be useful.

# ── CENSUS 3: what is still RETIRED, which is the inverse of the work done ───
# Outside WIKI / STYLE GUIDE / DOCUMENT MANAGEMENT: 403 nodes, 414 references, two agreeing sweeps.
# File-wide: 1423 references. Per-style breakdown is in deprecated-collection-census.tsv; the 35
# that sit inside a component are in deprecated-shipped-worklist.tsv.
# HOW TO USE THIS. Re-run the same sweeps (docs/figma-rebind-deprecated.js with WRITE=false gives
# census 3; census 1 and 2 are a findAll over boundVariables.fills/strokes). If census 3 has GROWN
# or census 1 has SHRUNK and nobody has been working, the file has moved underneath us.
# TWO AGREEING SWEEPS, ALWAYS. A cold findAll under-reports per PREDICATE — this repo has had
# 2-of-15, 38-of-277 and 103-of-203 from a first pass. Every number above is the second of two runs
# that agreed. A single sweep that disagrees with this file is not evidence of a rollback; it is
# evidence you need to sweep again.
